main_visual_task: Follow one cold-water drop as it visibly wets coffee grounds and reveals a continuous dark coffee surface.

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same bed of coarse dark-roasted coffee grounds and one clear cold-water drop
prompt_bible.environment_lock: dark walnut tabletop, seamless black background, no people
prompt_bible.material_lock: real granular coffee grounds, transparent water, visibly wet porous coffee, dark brown coffee liquid
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: warm narrow side backlight from upper right, faint cool fill from left, no lighting change
prompt_bible.palette_lock: espresso brown, walnut brown, warm amber highlights, black background
prompt_bible.lens_texture: photoreal macro cinema lens, shallow depth of field, natural micro-texture, no CGI geometry
prompt_bible.screen_direction: water and camera travel from upper center downward; preserve direction throughout
prompt_bible.audio_policy: close-miked water drop, wet absorption and low room tone; no music, no voice

timeline.visual_state: dry coffee granules fill the frame and one clear drop hangs above them
timeline.subject_action: the drop slowly descends toward a visible pore between granules
timeline.camera_action: locked macro start, then a very short downward tracking motion begins
timeline.focus: drop surface and the exact contact point
timeline.lighting_state: warm rim light reveals transparent water and oily coffee texture
timeline.end_state: drop is one millimeter above the grounds

timeline.visual_state: the drop touches the dry porous surface
timeline.subject_action: water flattens, enters gaps and creates an irregular wet edge
timeline.camera_action: track downward with the contact, no cut and no orbit
timeline.focus: contact line and granular capillary absorption
timeline.end_state: a small dark wet patch is clearly visible

timeline.visual_state: wet patch expands through connected coffee granules
timeline.subject_action: thin real liquid channels merge; granules darken progressively from center outward
timeline.camera_action: continue one smooth arc fifteen degrees to the right while slowly pulling back
timeline.focus: rack focus from the leading wet edge to connected liquid channels
timeline.lighting_state: same light direction, amber highlights move only because camera moves
timeline.end_state: several channels have merged into one coherent dark pool

timeline.visual_state: the coherent coffee pool now reveals the curved edge of a glass vessel
timeline.subject_action: the liquid surface rises slightly and settles with small physical ripples
timeline.camera_action: complete the same pullback and lower to a shallow side angle
timeline.focus: transition from wet grounds to the complete liquid surface and glass edge
timeline.lighting_state: warm rim outlines the glass edge, cool fill preserves liquid detail
timeline.end_state: the whole coffee surface and glass edge are readable

timeline.visual_state: stable dark coffee surface inside the same glass edge
timeline.subject_action: ripples decelerate naturally until almost still
timeline.camera_action: camera decelerates to a complete stop
timeline.focus: locked on the surface highlight and glass edge
timeline.end_state: clean stable endpoint for a matched edit

camera_plan.motivation: the camera behaves like an observer following the physical cause from drop to absorbed liquid, then reveals the result
camera_plan.start_position: top-down macro, six centimeters above the coffee grounds
camera_plan.path: track down with the drop, continue into a shallow fifteen-degree right arc, then pull back and lower to reveal the glass edge
camera_plan.speed_curve: very slow opening, brief medium acceleration at contact, smooth slow pullback, full deceleration for the final two seconds
camera_plan.focus_transition: drop surface to contact edge to connected liquid channels to full coffee surface and glass edge
camera_plan.end_position: shallow thirty-degree side angle, medium close-up of coffee surface and glass edge
camera_plan.axis_lock: never cross the water travel axis; downward motion stays downward on screen
camera_plan.stop_condition: stop only after the liquid ripples have visibly settled

first_frame: dry coffee grounds in extreme macro with one transparent water drop above the exact center contact point
last_frame: stable dark coffee surface and curved glass edge, no text, no logo, no camera motion
